title: Finite-constant-normalized completed DVR coefficient comparison
statement: Let l be prime, E/Q_l a finite extension with integers O_E and recorded uniformizer [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], and let d be an adic coefficient datum on O_E with ideal generated by that uniformizer [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum]. For any scheme T on the small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], there exists an IntegralResidueCoefficientModel: finite coefficient ring-sheaf isomorphisms from the continuous quotient-function sheaves to completedAdicFiniteRing T d n, sending each constant residue to that same residue, commuting with quotient transitions, and an isomorphism completedAdicCommRing T d to the inverse-limit integral ring sheaf [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients], with each limit projection commuting with the finite comparison. Only these five coefficient fields are asserted, with no module-completeness or open-operation criterion.

proof.text: Identify each finite constant quotient sheaf with its continuous component-function presentation. The comparison is fixed on constant sections. Naturality on those sections proves commutation with quotient transition maps.

    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E]

    (T : Scheme.{u}) : Nonempty (IntegralResidueCoefficientModel l E d T)
